themes.description: Users experienced issues with withdrawing funds, with some transactions being debited but not credited, and customer support failing to address the issue. App crashes also occurred when attempting to withdraw funds.
themes.business_impact: Significant reputational damage and loss of user trust, potential long-term revenue impact due to decreased user engagement and investment in other services.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app's architecture and system integration may be flawed, leading to transaction errors and inability to process withdrawals.
themes.action_plan: • Re-engineer withdrawal process to ensure seamless transactions, Implement robust customer support mechanisms to address transaction errors, Conduct thorough testing to prevent app crashes, Collaborate with system integrators to resolve underlying technical issues.

themes.description: Users report various issues with bonds and fixed deposits (FDs) on the app, including lack of available bond options, incorrect interest rates, and problems with investing and withdrawing funds. They also express dissatisfaction with the customer support team.
themes.business_impact: Loss of customer trust, high risk of negative reviews and word-of-mouth, and potential negative impact on overall app reputation.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The underlying cause of this issue is a combination of technical problems, inadequate customer support, and a lack of transparency in bond and FD offerings.
themes.action_plan:
• Investigate and fix technical issues related to bond and FD investing and withdrawing, improve customer support knowledge and response times, and provide clear and accurate information about bond and FD options and interest rates
• Develop a plan to increase transparency and provide users with more control over their investments
• Create a system for users to report and track issues with bonds and FDs
